reviewerStatement: User-delegated AI review by Codex of all 44 development validator cases, using the request text, canonical RGB views and measured bounds. I also performed the preceding relevance review and had earlier exposure to some asset descriptions; this is a reassessment by the same AI, not a second independent reviewer, human adjudication or untouched holdout evidence. I inspected the complete validator overview, reopened new and ambiguous twelve-view sheets, and reused hash-unchanged sheets already examined. Verdicts and reasons were fixed before this step compared them with stored proposals. The required reviewMethod identifies the workflow stage; it does not override this independence disclosure. Unknown functional or material properties remain uncertain; known contradictions take precedence. No model execution or qualification is authorized by this file.

cases.note: The views show a bent brown palm trunk with sparse bright-green fronds. Measured extents 7.726 x 4.521 x 4.294 m satisfy all supplied limits.
The asset is an upright conifer with layered foliage, not a bent tropical palm with sparse fronds.
The views show a bare low mound without the requested scattered pale bones; acceptable bounds do not resolve that identity contradiction.
Multiple pale bones are visibly scattered over an irregular gray mound. The 2.605 x 0.771 x 2.402 m extents satisfy the supplied box.
A complete closed chest is visible, with brown wooden slats, an arched lid and gray bands. Its 1.234 x 0.690 x 0.731 m bounds fit; no working hinge is required by this request.

The complete closed chest silhouette and arched panelled lid fit, but uniformly white/gray renders do not establish the requested wooden surfaces and distinct gray metal bands. Do not infer a missing material assignment from the name.
Closed arched chest geometry and dimensions fit. The uniformly white/gray appearance leaves the required wood and gray metal material distinction unestablished by the supplied evidence.
The candidate is an open chest base with visible contents and no closed arched lid. It cannot satisfy the explicitly complete closed-chest request as supplied.

A curved dirt track, grassy margins, stones and open route ends are visible. Bounds 6.386 x 0.518 x 6.406 m fit the supplied box. This establishes the requested segment appearance, not compatibility with an unspecified kit.
The candidate is a desktop monitor with a stand, not a dirt-road segment.
Only one monitor is present; the request explicitly requires a complete three-monitor rig.

Three screens on a shared central support are visible and measured width is 1.928 m. The static views suggest articulated support arms but do not establish actual adjustability; a curved arrangement alone also does not prove each panel's required curvature.
The views show a curved recessed dry channel with earthen walls, grass and stones, rather than a continuous level road surface. Bounds 5.489 x 1.310 x 5.626 m satisfy the supplied box.
The candidate is a desktop monitor, not a dry earthen channel or ditch.
One beige faceted pillar-shaped piece with a capped top is visible, measuring 1.214 m high. It matches the requested piece form and bounds without asserting any specific kit role, socket or mate.

The visible post is gray/green-gray rather than the requested beige pillar. Its compliant maximum dimensions do not establish the requested appearance; thinness alone is not used as the rejection reason.

At the supplied scale the bridge's longitudinal extent is 5.94197 m, shorter than the explicitly requested six-metre gap. No resizing is authorized. Safe player traversal is also unverified, but the known span shortfall is already a contradiction.
This is an empty polygonal drinking cup. It lacks both a shallow fruit bowl and the requested bananas and mixed fruit.
The shallow tabletop container visibly holds bananas and red, green and orange fruit. Bounds 0.430 x 0.230 x 0.401 m satisfy the supplied limits.
The candidate is a gray office chair with armrests and a wheeled base, not a mustard-yellow beanbag.
The faceted mustard-yellow beanbag has a clear seat hollow and raised back. Its roughly 1.13 m width and remaining dimensions fit the request and supplied limits.
The candidate is a small rounded plant-like form with a long green stem. It has none of the requested four-way asphalt road, lane arrows, crossings, sidewalks or traffic lights.
The plate contains one receptacle with two prong slots, not two receptacles. The visible count contradicts the two-socket requirement regardless of the separately unverified power behavior.

Two receptacles are visible on a wall plate, but rendered geometry and bounds provide no evidence that it supplies power to devices. Appearance cannot establish the explicit electrical-function requirement.

This is a small wall-backed fountain with two basin levels. It lacks the requested round three-basin composition, winged statue and visible water jets, and is only about 1.04 m wide rather than about 3 m.

Three brown cap-like forms are present and height is 0.378 m, but they are vertically staggered with no visible stems or common ground support. The views do not establish a complete mushroom cluster suitable as groundcover; do not infer attachment purpose from a filename.
The candidate is a red-orange conical hat with a purple band, not three brown mushrooms.
Three brown mushroom caps with pale stems form a small cluster. The faceted rounded cap silhouettes fit the low-poly request and measured height 0.454 m is below half a metre.
Three small brown mushrooms with pale stems are visible. Their stylized rounded/faceted caps are consistent with low-poly groundcover; measured height 0.477 m is below half a metre.
A red-orange upper cone and purple lower band visibly form the requested two-tone party hat. Measured height 0.256 m is below 30 cm.
The candidate is a rectangular wall outlet plate with two receptacles, not a conical party hat.
The wooden bridge has an arched deck and railings on both sides. Bounds 3.063 x 2.128 x 5.942 m fit 3.5 x 2.5 x 6.5 m. This request does not require verified gameplay load capacity.
The candidate is a narrow sword-shaped wooden prop, with no bridge deck, arch or paired railings.
A brown trunk supports a faceted green crown with clearly visible white snow patches. Bounds 2.849 x 5.845 x 3.055 m satisfy the stated height and footprint limits.
The tree has a green conifer canopy without visible snow, contradicting the explicit snow-covered crown requirement.

The compact device visibly has a blue cutting bed, straight guide rail and black sliding cutter. Its 0.547 m length and other dimensions fit. The request describes a trimmer prop, without an explicit working gameplay-cutting requirement.
The candidate is a thin printed paper sheet; there is no cutting bed, guide rail or cutter assembly.
One upright irregular gray faceted boulder with a flattened top is visible. Bounds 0.719 x 1.298 x 0.629 m fit the supplied box and approximately 1.3 m height.
The candidate is a thin green rod or stem with a small gray tip, not a substantial upright gray boulder.

The closed wooden treasure chest is visually plausible, but static views and part counts do not establish weatherproofing or a lid that opens during gameplay. Neither behavior can be inferred from the visible lid seam.
The candidate is an arched wooden footbridge, not a treasure chest.

A closed chest with an arched lid is visible. The supplied evidence establishes neither weatherproofing nor working gameplay articulation; uniformly white/gray rendering also leaves wood appearance unresolved.
The geometry resembles a closed treasure chest, but neither weatherproofing nor a gameplay-operable hinge is demonstrated. White/gray renders are insufficient to establish the wooden style.

The arched closed chest and separate-looking lid are visible, but two measured parts do not prove a functional hinge. Weatherproofing and gameplay opening remain unverified, and wood appearance is unresolved in the white/gray renders.
